messages.subject: Harledge - first monthly reporting pack under the amended facility
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona,

Now that we've completed, a reminder that the first management accounts pack under the amended facility is due within 21 days of month-end, and the December management accounts evidencing the £2.1m EBITDA milestone trigger the £3m Tranche B. Please send through when ready and we'll progress the Tranche B drawdown.

Tom Beckett | Relationship Director | Pennine Business Bank plc
